title: feat(rendbl): ridge-enter doubled pairing holds k=1..4
science: The band's only body-diagonal arrival table: under kappa t(1,1,1)=5, t(2,2,2)=10, t(3,3,3)=13, t(4,4,4)=16 — i.e. t(k,k,k)=3k+4 for k>=2, the law that (with t_axis=k+12) fixes the wall.
